definitions.explanation: Describes an action or state that continues without interruption. Somewhat more literary or formal than いつも.

examples.japanese: ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絶|た}えず⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絶|た}えず⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}している→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
examples.english: He is constantly challenging himself with new things.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絶|た}えず⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧さらされて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This region is constantly exposed to the danger of earthquakes.

notes:
USAGE:
{絶|た}えず is an adverb derived from the verb ⟦{絶|た}える→絶える：13814_taeru⟧ (to cease, to run out) with the negative ず form. It literally means "without ceasing."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {絶|た}えず: constantly, without interruption (slightly literary)
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧: always, at all times (everyday usage)
- ⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: invariably, at all times (formal)
- ⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧: continuously, the whole time (casual)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶|た}えず⟦{変化|へんか}する→変化する：20997_henkasuru⟧ (to change constantly)
- {絶|た}えず⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧ (to make constant effort)
- {絶|た}えず⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧ (to flow ceaselessly)
